description:
List the webhook endpoints registered on the authenticated account (its secret is withheld on this server). Each endpoint includes its id, URL, subscribed events, status (ACTIVE|DISABLED), consecutive failure count, last success/failure timestamps, last error, and signing secret. Porkbun POSTs a signed JSON payload to each endpoint when subscribed events occur; deliveries are signed with the endpoint's secret via HMAC-SHA256 over `{timestamp}.{rawBody}` and sent in the `X-Porkbun-Signature` header.

On this server a secret field in the result is withheld: a secret leaves this server only in the result of a money tool, which the client asks the user to approve (for a webhook, rotate_webhook_secret); the account holder also sees it at https://porkbun.com/account/api.
name: list_webhooks
